Log feedback about termag that a person gave: praise, a problem, an idea.

Usage: termag feedback [--kind praise|problem|idea|other] [--agent <agent>] [--model <model>] (<text> | - < feedback.md)

The text is the person's feedback about termag, in their words: one argument, or `-` to read it from stdin.
Text that starts with a dash goes after `--`: termag feedback -- "- the sidebar is confusing".
Kinds: praise, problem, idea, other (default other). At most 5000 characters.
The CLI version, the agent and model (from the environment, or --agent / --model) and this session's project and workstream are attached.
Secret-shaped strings (tokens, keys) are replaced with [redacted: …] before sending.
Prints the feedback's id. Only admins read feedback, at /admin/feedback.

Global flags:
  --json          Machine-readable output
  --yes           Skip confirmations
  --host <url>    Orchestrator to use (or TERMAG_URL). Default: the production orchestrator,
                  or this box's own orchestrator when run on a box
  -h, --help      Show help
  --version       Show the version

Exit codes: 0 ok, 1 failed, 2 usage error, 3 not found, 4 auth needed, 5 timeout.
